annotations.title: What the journey's next run would charge, on each of its models, and what's left to spend

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/journeys/{journey}/quote. What the journey's next run would charge, on each of its models, and what's left to spend. Call this before running a journey now, or to tell your person what one costs: each model's estimate a run (typical, and high: about the 90th percentile), how the estimate was made, the team's budget left this month and its prepaid credit. Runs are charged each run at model cost plus 50%, at least $0.02. A run goes ahead only when its high estimate fits the budget left (and, without a card, the credit).

journey.description: the journey's slug, as in its page's address /sites/{slug}/journeys/{journey}

name: sites_by_slug_journeys_by_journey_quote

budgetLeftUsd.description: the team's monthly journey budget less this month's charges, US dollars; null when it has none

creditUsd.description: the team's prepaid journey credit, US dollars; null for a team we don't bill

journeysRun.description: whether the team's journeys may run (a card, credit, or a team we don't bill)

models.description: one estimate per model the journey runs on

basis.description: how the estimate was made, in words

highUsd.description: about the 90th percentile of a run's charge, US dollars: what the budget check uses

typicalUsd.description: a typical run's charge, US dollars

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
